highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 will improve filtered-image and glyph rendering without changing public APIs.
highlights_body: The upcoming native update tightens texture-subset sampling and makes image-filter cache-key comparisons consistent with hashing.

bullets.lead: Keep filtered images within texture subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects Ganesh texture sampling when minification, strong skew, antialiasing, or multisampling extends coordinates beyond image geometry. Retains clamping where padding is insufficient and respects logical texture bounds to avoid sampling unrelated backing-texture pixels.
Aligns image-filter cache-key equality with its bytewise hash, including signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata, so key lookup and LRU eviction use consistent key identity.

Respects regenerated glyph paths, formats, and bounds when font-scaler loads disagree. Clears incompatible masks and uses full plane strides for clipped emboss masks, avoiding stale rendering, sub-byte buffer overwrites, format assertions, and corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
